status: Selection and comparison rules fixed before new model scores; comparator/reference preparation remains
purpose: Prospective matched comparison of model effect magnitudes against archived statistical prioritization at three previously unscored PSC regions
freeze_context: Archive PIPs, Table 1, prior pilot results and the nine shortlisted rsIDs' database mappings were inspected before this protocol. No AlphaGenome score for these selected regions has been requested or inspected in this project. This is a local protocol freeze, not a registry preregistration.

locus_selection.region_label_note: BCL211 to BCL2L11 is an archive-region link supported by the shared rs72837826 record; this is not a claim that the causal gene is established.
locus_selection.source_provenance_limits: Use published set size only as a selection field. No exact per-signal credible membership is inferred, and log/model discrepancies remain unresolved. Low PIPs are model-dependent comparison labels.

anchor_selection.identifier_requirement: One literal rsID with unique primary-chromosome forward-strand mapping on GRCh37 and GRCh38
anchor_selection.allele_requirement: Exactly two distinct A/C/G/T single-base database alleles, identical across builds; verify reference against both Ensembl sequences and AlphaGenome GRCh38.p13 FASTA
anchor_selection.on_exclusion: Record every high-PIP source record, its reason and any unresolved alleles. Do not lower the PIP threshold or replace a region. Retain fewer anchors when necessary.
anchor_selection.risk_direction: Unspecified. Compare ALT minus REF and its magnitude; do not transfer risk alleles from proxies or infer risk from REF/ALT.

comparators.name: Low-PIP comparison variants, not experimentally established negatives
comparators.source_pool: All archived SNP rows in the same selected region
comparators.reference_requirements: Same unique rsID, two-build, biallelic SNV and reference-base checks as anchors
comparators.population_reference: 1000 Genomes phase 3 release 20130502, EUR samples in the pinned sample panel
comparators.maf_applicability: Both anchors and comparators must satisfy the minimum EUR MAF; current anchor nomination remains conditional on this check
comparators.maf_denominator: All called EUR alleles at each variant; missing genotypes remain missing
comparators.ld_definition: Squared Pearson correlation of ALT dosages in jointly called EUR donors; a zero-variance or missing comparison is unavailable, never zero LD
comparators.ld_screen: Each comparator against every reference-resolved high-PIP biallelic SNV in that region, including unused reserves; also against already assigned comparators. Unresolved aliases, indels and multiallelic records are outside this screen and must be disclosed.
comparators.functional_context: Match Ensembl VEP most-severe noncoding class: intron, 5-prime UTR, 3-prime UTR, or intergenic/upstream/downstream. Exclude protein-altering and canonical splice-site variants in both arms; preserve actual terms.
comparators.tss_distance: Distance to nearest annotated gene TSS in the fixed region gene universe. Absolute difference in log10(distance_bp + 1) must be <= 0.5.
comparators.assignment: Within each region, process anchors in descending PIP then numeric rsID order. Rank eligible comparators by cost, then numeric rsID; select the first pair also satisfying their mutual LD screen. Prohibit reuse. If no pair exists, record that anchor as unmatched and do not relax criteria.
comparators.gate: Freeze exact anchor/comparator identities, all matching covariates and source hashes before any model predictions. Missing required covariates or LD excludes a pair; substitutions after score inspection are prohibited.

model.model_choice_reason: Fixed exploratory comparison using the same selection as the feasibility pilot. Official documentation describes ALL_FOLDS as trained across genomic folds; this does not test held-out genomic generalization or establish donor independence.
model.interval_center: Highest-PIP reference-eligible anchor in each region, using its GRCh38 position minus one as the center coordinate. Use that identical interval for every anchor and comparator at the region; start0=center0-524288, end0=start0+1048576.
model.primary_context: CD4-positive alpha-beta T-cell RNA-seq tracks; generic context, not a claim of PSC-specific or stimulation-state coverage
model.gene_universe: All uniquely annotated gene TSSs inside the fixed region interval, intersected with the model's annotated genes. Pin this universe and exact track identities before predictions; use the same complete universe for every matched variant at the region.
model.missing_outputs: Missing/nonfinite gene or track output makes the affected comparison unavailable; do not silently shrink the gene universe, switch tissues, or treat missing as zero.
model.request_scope: Only matched anchor-plus-two-comparator groups; no outcome-driven rescoring or additional exploratory tissues in the primary batch

analysis.gene_effect: For each variant and fixed gene, median across the pinned primary tracks of the absolute RNA_SEQ raw score
analysis.variant_effect: Maximum gene_effect over the fixed region gene universe; keep the maximizing gene and every gene score
analysis.anchor_contrast: Anchor variant_effect minus the median variant_effect of its two matched comparators
analysis.primary_reporting_unit: Region; report the median anchor_contrast within each region, plus every anchor/comparator result
analysis.cross_region_summary: Median of the region contrasts with equal weight per included region. Report the denominator and all excluded/unmatched regions. With three planned regions, no accuracy percentage, generalization estimate, nominal association P-value or calibrated causal probability is claimed.
analysis.nearest_tss_baseline: For each variant, report nearest-TSS gene and the AlphaGenome rank of that gene within the identical fixed universe; agreement is descriptive because these regions lack established causal-gene truth labels
analysis.secondary_reporting: Retain signed ALT-minus-REF gene scores; no expected disease-risk sign is assigned. Report whether the highest-scoring gene matches the region label as descriptive context only.
prohibited_transforms: Normalizing multicause marginal PIPs into a credible set
Multiplying PIP by model scores to claim a causal posterior
Counting correlated variants as independent replications
Selecting a model fold, cell type, threshold or window after viewing the best result

completion_gates_before_inference: Verify all selected input bases and both genome builds
Pin reference gene annotation, exact scorer/track metadata and identical per-region windows
Build and validate both matched comparators for each included anchor, with MAF, context, TSS distance and LD
Record all high-PIP exclusions and incomplete LD-screen coverage
Freeze the final input manifest and matching table, with hashes and timestamp
Report source-run provenance as unresolved and independence as unestablished; author correspondence is optional for the limited exploratory comparison
